name: peeramid-labs
description: Peeramid Labs developer-tool plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: quorum
plugins.description: Multi-agent deliberation CLI. /quorum:init, /quorum:redeem, /quorum:run, /quorum:serve, /quorum:status, /quorum:trace, /quorum:validate, /quorum:tui — wrap the quorum-cli binary with Claude-driven prompts, .env auto-detection, and post-run diagnosis.

plugins.name: sloppoke
plugins.description: Pre-commit AI-slop firewall. /slop:poke, /slop:apply, /slop:learn, /slop:status, /slop:install-hook wrap the slop CLI. PreToolUse hook auto-gates every `git commit` Claude attempts via Bash and surfaces the verdict + patch before the commit lands.
